description: Round 62, batch A. Answers a REAL model (qwen2.5:7b via Ollama, through the real governed loop and tools, on a throw-away repository with known contents) gave, labelled from ground truth by scripts/collect_real_verify_cases.py - not written by the author of the rules. ALL of batch A is DEVELOPMENT data: the author read every answer in it before changing the rules (an even/odd split would have been a contaminated holdout). The holdout is batch B (collected afterwards with different goals, labelled by the same script, its answers not read before the measurement).
